A query is evaluated iff its relevant list is non-empty. Per-query: recall = |retrieved[:5] ∩ relevant| / |relevant|; precision = |retrieved[:5] ∩ relevant| / 5; reciprocal rank = 1 / position (1-based) of the first retrieved example that is in relevant, else 0; hit = that intersection is non-empty; empty = retrieved list is empty. queries_total = number of rows; queries_evaluated = number of evaluated rows; recall_at_k, precision_at_k and mrr are the means of recall, precision and reciprocal rank over the evaluated rows only (unevaluated rows are not included as zeros); hit_rate = evaluated rows with hit true / queries_evaluated; empty_rate = rows with empty true / queries_total. Round every rate to 4 decimals. Latency percentiles are nearest-rank over all 15 latencies sorted ascending: p50 is the value at 1-based position 8 and p95 the value at position 15 (ceil(50/100*15)=8, ceil(95/100*15)=15); copy those two latency values exactly.
